en: A colorized vintage postcard view of a busy harbor at the entrance of a canal. Steamships and sailing vessels line the waterway and quays, with low-rise buildings and warehouses along the waterfront in the foreground. The canal stretches into the distance through flat desert landscape. Printed caption text at the top left reads "PORT-SAID — Entrance of the Suez Canal," and a website watermark appears at the bottom right.
